Protecting Families. Empowering Communities.

Every family deserves to feel safe at home.

Purple Shield Foundation protects and empowers people experiencing domestic and family violence in Australia — combining real-time reporting technology, safe housing, education, and policy advocacy to help families move from crisis to safety.

Our Mission

“Purple Shield Foundation exists to protect, support, and empower people experiencing domestic and family violence — advancing their safety and long-term wellbeing through technology, education, safe housing, and policy advocacy, in collaboration with government, industry, and community.”

Protective
A shield, literally and figuratively — safety and refuge sit at the center of everything.
Compassionate
Survivor-centered, trauma-informed, warm — never clinical or distant.
Trustworthy
Governed by a formal constitution and board; credibility matters to donors and regulators alike.
Empowering
Alongside families, not for them — codesigned programs, not top-down charity.
What We Do

Five pillars, one mission

Everything we build supports one or more of these pillars, working alongside government, industry, and community.

01

Safety

Helping people experiencing domestic and family violence access support and protection.

02

Technology

Developing innovative solutions that improve reporting and access to services.

03

Education

Promoting respectful relationships and community awareness.

04

Advocacy

Influencing policy and systemic change.

05

Partnership

Working with governments, businesses, charities, Rotary, sponsors, and communities.
